If reference clock frequency is lower and LBU can not support high baud rate of UART, then FW will set soc_use_ref_mode = 0. This is an indication for Bluetooth subsystem that there is some IP which need PLL to function which is LBU in this case.

field.description: CPU1 Message for CPU2 is ready. This is self clearing bit. The CPU1 writes 1 to indicate that message for CPU2 is ready. This generates an Interrupt to CPU2 via APU. This is old schem and we should use IMU based scheme.

field.name: cpu3_to_cpu2_msg_rdy
field.description: CPU3 Message for CPU2 is ready. This is self clearing bit. The CPU3 writes 1 to indicate that message for CPU2 is ready. This generates an Interrupt to CPU2 via APU. This is old schem and we should use IMU based scheme.

field.name: cpu1_to_cpu2_msg_process_done
field.description: CPU1 Message for CPU2 has been read by CPU2 and executed. This is self clearing bit. The CPU2 writes 1 to indicate that message send by CPU1 is executed. This generates an Interrupt to CPU1 via CIU1.

field.name: cpu3_to_cpu2_msg_process_done
field.description: CPU3 Message for CPU2 has been read by CPU2 and executed. This is self clearing bit. The CPU2 writes 1 to indicate that message send by CPU3 is executed. This generates an Interrupt to CPU3 via CIU3.

field.name: ahb2_timeout_clear
field.description: After the timeout happended on AHB2 bus, the cpu will read the ERR ISR and read the bus state which cause the timeout and then set this bit to 1 to clear the AHB2 timeout logic to start recroding next transaction. This is self clearing bit

field.name: cpu2_dcode_inv_addr_clr
field.description: After the invalid address int happended on CPU2 dcode bus, the cpu2 will read the ERR ISR and read the bus state which cause the timeout and then set this bit to 1 to clear the CPU2 Dcode invalid addr logic to start recroding next transaction. This is self clearing bit

field.name: cpu2_icode_inv_addr_clr
field.description: After the invalid address int happended on CPU2 icode bus, the cpu2 will read the ERR ISR and read the bus state which cause the timeout and then set this bit to 1 to clear the CPU2 Icode invalid addr logic to start recroding next transaction. This is self clearing bit

field.name: cpu1_jtag_chain_bypass
field.description: 1 = Bypass the JTAG chain of CPU1 0 = The CPU1 remains in JTAG chain This bit is backup in case the CPU1 doesn't work on silicon.

field.name: cpu1_cpu2_msg_scheme
field.description: 1 = new IMU based scheme (default) 0 = old ciu reg based scheme

register.name: BLE_REG_PST_ANCHR_OFST_0
register.description: Periodic SW Timer 0: First Anchor Offset

field.name: anchr_corr_time
field.description: Anchor Point To Correlation Hit Time

enumeratedValue.name: zero
enumeratedValue.description: Substract adj_ast_ofst from ISO_Intvl_Tmr value counting toward next BIS/CIS event, effectively moving next BIS/CIS anchor point to a earlier time. This is used when the averaged anchr_corr_time value is gradually decreasing, indicating the slave device's local clock is drifting slower.

enumeratedValue.name: one
enumeratedValue.description: Add adj_ast_ofst to ISO_Intvl_Tmr value counting toward next BIS/CIS event, effectively delaying next BIS/CIS anchor point to a later time. This is used when the averaged anchr_corr_time value is gradually increasing, indicating the slave device's local clock is drifting faster.

enumeratedValue.name: V0
enumeratedValue.description: select 100us range. For master, BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_MST from rifRx rising edge of each Rx ID packet. For slave, BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_SLV from rifRx rising edge of the Rx FHS packet.

enumeratedValue.name: V1
enumeratedValue.description: select 600us range. For master, BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_MST from rifTx rising edge of the first Tx ID packet. For slave, BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_SLV from correlation hit of the first or second Rx ID packet.

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOACK_0
enumeratedValue.description: sequence manager will not follow a receive frame with a Tx Ack frame, under any conditions; the autosequence will terminate after the receive frame.

enumeratedValue.name: AUTOACK_1
enumeratedValue.description: sequence manager will follow a receive frame with an automatic hardware-generated Tx Ack frame, assuming other necessary conditions are met.

enumeratedValue.name: RXACKRQD_0
enumeratedValue.description: An ordinary receive frame (any type of frame) follows the transmit frame.

enumeratedValue.name: RXACKRQD_1
enumeratedValue.description: A receive Ack frame is expected to follow the transmit frame (non-Ack frames are rejected).

enumeratedValue.name: CCABFRTX_0
enumeratedValue.description: no CCA required, transmit operation begins immediately.

enumeratedValue.name: CCABFRTX_1
enumeratedValue.description: at least one CCA measurement is required prior to the transmit operation (see also SLOTTED).

enumeratedValue.name: TMRTRIGEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: programmed sequence initiates immediately upon write to XCVSEQ.

enumeratedValue.name: TMRTRIGEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: allow timer TC2 (or TC2') to initiate a preprogrammed sequence (see XCVSEQ register).

enumeratedValue.name: SEQMSK_0
enumeratedValue.description: allows completion of an autosequence to generate a zigbee interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: SEQMSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Completion of an autosequence will set the SEQIRQ status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.name: TXMSK_0
enumeratedValue.description: allows completion of a TX operation to generate a zigbee interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: TXMSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Completion of a TX operation will set the TXIRQ status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.name: RXMSK_0
enumeratedValue.description: allows completion of a RX operation to generate a zigbee interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: RXMSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Completion of a RX operation will set the RXIRQ status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.name: CCAMSK_0
enumeratedValue.description: allows completion of a CCA operation to generate a zigbee interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: CCAMSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Completion of a CCA operation will set the CCA status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.name: RX_WMRK_MSK_0
enumeratedValue.description: allows a Received Byte Count match to the RX_WTR_MARK threshold register to generate a zigbee interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: RX_WMRK_MSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: A Received Byte Count match to the RX_WTR_MARK threshold register will set the RXWTRMRKIRQ status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.description: allows Packet Processor Filtering Failure to generate a zigbee interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: FILTERFAIL_MSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: A Packet Processor Filtering Failure will set the FILTERFAIL_IRQ status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.name: PLL_UNLOCK_MSK_0
enumeratedValue.description: allows PLL unlock event to generate a zigbee interrupt

enumeratedValue.name: PLL_UNLOCK_MSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: A PLL unlock event will set the PLL_UNLOCK_IRQ status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.description: sequence manager ignores CRCVALID and considers the receive operation complete after the last octet of the frame has been received.

enumeratedValue.name: CRC_MSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: sequence manager requires CRCVALID=1 at the end of the received frame in order for the receive operation to complete successfully; if CRCVALID=0, sequence manager will return to preamble-detect mode after the last octet of the frame has been received.

enumeratedValue.name: WAKE_MSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Wakeup from DSM will set the WAKE_IRQ status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.name: ARB_GRANT_DEASSERTION_MSK_1
enumeratedValue.description: An arb_grant deassertion event will set the ARB_GRANT_DEASSERTION_IRQ status bit, but a zigbee interrupt is not generated

enumeratedValue.name: TSM_MSK_0

enumeratedValue.name: TSM_MSK_1

field.name: AA_COR_THRESH
field.description: Threshold use to compare the correlation magnitude in the long-range AA correlator.

field.name: AA_HAM_THRESH
field.description: Threshold use to compare the Hamming distance, between reference coded sequence and received coded sequence, in the long-range AA correlator.

field.name: ACCESS_ADDR_HAM
field.description: Threshold use to compare the Hamming distance, between the reference AA sequence and the received Viterbi decoded AA sequence.

field.name: AA_LR_CORR_GAIN
field.description: AA correlator gain. Format ufix6en3. This gain is applied to soft bits from the demodulator before they are used for address search synchronization.

field.name: DECODED_HAMM_DIST
field.description: Hamming distance between the reference sequence and the Viterbi decoded received sequence

field.name: AA_FOUND
field.description: Indicates that a AA detect is active for both LR and uncoded.

field.name: CODED_HAMM_DIST
field.description: Hamming distance between the coded reference sequence and the coded received sequence.

field.name: AA_CORR_MAX
field.description: Indicates the AA correlation magnitude witnessed when AA match occurred

field.name: CMAG_MAX
field.description: Indicates the maximum preamble correlation magnitude during preamble found

enumeratedValue.name: A1
enumeratedValue.description: Use preamble and verify a correlation peak, the synch at the symbol rate as symbol timing is established by the preamble acquisition

enumeratedValue.name: A2
enumeratedValue.description: Use synch only (which may incorporate part of the preamble)

enumeratedValue.name: A3
enumeratedValue.description: Use mainly the sync detection: Use a low threshold on the preamble detector and launch the synch detection only if the preamble has shown a recent peak

field.name: EN_PHY_SM_EXT_RST
field.description: Enable PHY state-machine reset on the external reset port; Reserved, should keep 0.

enumeratedValue.name: A0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not allowed.

enumeratedValue.name: A1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is allowed.

field.name: AGC_FRZ_ON_PD_FOUND_ACQ1_LR
field.description: Specifies AGC freeze condition for non-coded acq.1 and Bluetooth LE long range.

enumeratedValue.name: A1
enumeratedValue.description: AGC freeze on AA found.

enumeratedValue.name: A0
enumeratedValue.description: AGC freeze asserted on PD found.

field.name: PH_BUFF_PTR_SYM
field.description: Phase buffer size to demodulator, long range only.

field.name: EARLY_PD_TIMEOUT
field.description: Time-out used to reset the AGC state-machine for the eventuality that an "PD found early" , expressed in number of sample clock cycles. Event occurs but it is not followed by an "PD found" event

field.name: AA_TIMEOUT_UNCODED
field.description: Time-out value for access address search for uncoded packets, expressed in number of sample clock cycles

field.name: RSSI_CORR_TH
field.description: Threshold use to compare a correlation magnitude value, computed in the acquisition block, in order to determine the correlation flag value provided by the PHY to the LQI computation block. Format is ufix8_En8

field.name: RTT_CFO

field.description: Difference between the squared correlation magnitude values, pm-pp provided by the HARTT block, format is sfix10En9.

field.name: RTT_DIST_SAT
field.description: Computed Hamming distance saturated to 2 bits, format is ufix2.

field.name: HA_RTT_THRESHOLD
field.description: threshold used to validate a HA RTT result.

field.name: RTT_SEQ_LEN

field.description: Enables overriding the programmed AA bits with the PN sequence used by RTT;

register.name: RFMCCFG
register.description: Radio Flash Memory Controller Configuration Register

enumeratedValue.name: CK_0
enumeratedValue.description: Normal configuration. When NBU CPU executes WFI and SLEEP_EN=1 (or if NBU CPU reset is asserted), and a sleep request from RFMC (LP_ENTER) NBU, MAN or WOR is asserted, the flash is put in low power, the sleep_rdy to RFMC asserts and the FRO will be disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: CK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Configuration where NBU, FRO and flash are not used. When NBU CPU reset is asserted, or NBU CPU executes WFI and SLEEP_EN=1, the flash will be placed in low power, the FRO disabled, the sleep_rdy to RFMC will assert and the NBU CM3 and AHB clocks will be gated off. The RF_CMC and NBU CPU will be without a clock until the next reset, but low power requests (RFMC LP_ENTER, MAN or WOR) will by accepted by RFMC since RF_CMC's sleep_rdy output will remain asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: CK_2
enumeratedValue.description: Configuration where NBU CPU is not used but FRO and flash can still be used. When NBU CPU reset is asserted, or NBU CPU executes WFI and SLEEP_EN=1, the clock to the NBU CPU will be gated. When RFMC (LP_ENTER), MAN or WOR request sleep, the flash is put in low power, the sleep_rdy to RFMC asserts and the FRO will be disabled as in configuration 00.

enumeratedValue.name: mode0
enumeratedValue.description: Frequency measurement performed with REF frequency > CUT Frequency.

enumeratedValue.name: mode1
enumeratedValue.description: Frequency measurement performed with REF frequency < CUT Frequency.

enumeratedValue.name: mode2
enumeratedValue.description: CUT period measurement performed.

enumeratedValue.name: mode3
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger based measurement performed. Note, each trigger pulse must be held for at least 2 ref_clk cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_START_POL0
enumeratedValue.description: Rising edge of TRIGGER[TRIG_START_SEL] will begin the measurement sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_START_POL1
enumeratedValue.description: Falling edge of TRIGGER[TRIG_START_SEL] will begin the measurement sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_END_POL0
enumeratedValue.description: Rising edge of TRIGER[TRIG_END_SEL] will end the measurement sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: TRIG_END_POL1
enumeratedValue.description: Falling edge of TRIGGER[TRIG_END_SEL] will end the measurement sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: SFA_TRIG_MEAS_EN0
enumeratedValue.description: The measurement will start by default with a dummy write to the REF and CUT counters.

enumeratedValue.name: SFA_TRIG_MEAS_EN1
enumeratedValue.description: The measurement will start after receiving a dummy write to the REF_CNT followed by receiving the trigger edge selected by TRIG_START_SEL and TRIG_START_POL.

enumeratedValue.name: SFA_IRQ_EN0
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupts are disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SFA_IRQ_EN1
enumeratedValue.description: Interrupts are enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SFA_EN0
enumeratedValue.description: The SFA is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SFA_EN1
enumeratedValue.description: The SFA is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: MONITOR_EN0
enumeratedValue.description: Not in monitor mode .

enumeratedValue.name: MONITOR_EN1
enumeratedValue.description: In monitor mode.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.name: IDE
field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.name: DLC
field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.

field.name: RTR
field.description: Remote Transmission Request. One/zero for remote/data frame.

field.description: ID Extended. One/zero for extended/standard format frame.

field.name: SRR
field.description: Substitute Remote Request. Contains a fixed recessive bit.

field.name: CODE
field.description: Message Buffer Code. This 4-bit field can be accessed (read or write) by the CPU and by the FlexCAN module itself, as part of the message buffer matching and arbitration process.

field.name: ESI
field.description: Error State Indicator. This bit indicates if the transmitting node is error active or error passive.

field.name: BRS
field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.description: Bit Rate Switch. This bit defines whether the bit rate is switched inside a CAN FD format frame.

field.name: EDL
field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.description: Extended Data Length. This bit distinguishes between CAN format and CAN FD format frames. The EDL bit must not be set for Message Buffers configured to RANSWER with code field 0b1010.

field.name: EXT
field.description: Contains extended (LOW word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: STD
field.description: Contains standard/extended (HIGH word) identifier of message buffer.

field.name: PRIO
field.description: Local priority. This 3-bit fieldis only used when LPRIO_EN bit is set in MCR and it only makes sense for Tx buffers. These bits are not transmitted. They are appended to the regular ID to define the transmission priority.

field.name: TIME_STAMP
field.description: Free-Running Counter Time stamp. This 16-bit field is a copy of the Free-Running Timer, captured for Tx and Rx frames at the time when the beginning of the Identifier field appears on the CAN bus.

field.description: Length of the data to be stored/transmitted.
